title: Entropic optimal transport need not select a zero-temperature limit
summary: We construct a compact metric space with an atomless probability measure and a bounded Lipschitz cost for which the entropic optimal-transport minimisers have no zero-temperature weak limit. More precisely, $P_\varepsilon$ does not converge as $\varepsilon\downarrow0$. In the example, every unregularised minimiser is singular with respect to $μ\otimesμ$, so that the entropy on the optimal face is identically $+\infty$.
